content.short: MyEtherWallet's multichain browser wallet for EVM chains, Polkadot, Bitcoin and Solana.
content.description: Built by the team behind MyEtherWallet, Enkrypt is a free, self-custodial browser extension that holds, buys, swaps and bridges tokens and manages NFTs. It supports every EVM chain plus Polkadot and Substrate networks, Bitcoin including Ordinals, Solana, Dogecoin and Litecoin, and users switch accounts and chains with a click. Unichain is among the dozens of networks it lists.
content.meta: Enkrypt, from MyEtherWallet, is a self-custodial browser wallet for EVM chains, Polkadot, Bitcoin, Solana and more.
